Wall Street Pledged $500 Billion for Nvidia. Not a Dollar Has Been Deployed.

Plus, Trump, Xi and Putin met in their first-ever summit, and Anthropic sells more shares than it planned at a higher price than expected for its IPO

1. FROM MY DESK

In August, then- Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang lined up pledges from Wall Street heavyweights—including Apollo, Blackstone, BlackRock and Goldman Sachs —to mobilize an astounding sum: $500 billion.

The wave of money was supposed to help Nvidia’s customers—including smaller, weaker ones—finance the chips they needed to buy, keeping the chip giant’s sales humming well into the future.
